name: CEM_IAModeler_CommandSet
description: Basic command collection for Revit AI assistance

commands.description: Displays a greeting dialog
get available family types
get current view elements
get current view info
get selected elements
Create point-based elements like furniture
Create line based element such as wall
Create surface-based elements like floors
Color elements by parameter value
Tag all the walls in the model
Deletes elements using ElementId
AI element filter for querying elements by criteria
Operate on elements (select, color, hide, isolate, etc)
Extract all rooms with detailed properties including area, volume, perimeter, and parameters
Calculate material quantities and takeoffs with area and volume calculations per material
Analyze model complexity with element counts by category, type, family, and level
Create grid system with smart spacing generation for project layout (alphabetic/numeric naming)
Create structural beam framing system with configurable spacing and direction
Create and place rooms at specified locations with custom names, numbers, and properties
Create tags for all rooms in the current view displaying room name and number
Create levels at specified elevations with automatic floor plan view generation
Execute dynamic C# code in Revit with access to the Document and Revit API
Capture a live screenshot of the Revit window (returns a PNG image) so the AI can visually evaluate the current result and decide how to improve it
Create dimension annotations between elements or points in the current view
Create reference planes by line, by origin+normal, or by three points (mm). Returns created element IDs
Create shared parameter definitions and bind them to categories (instance or type). Reuses existing definitions/bindings
Universal parameter writer: set instance/type parameters by name or BuiltInParameter across many elements (mm/deg in). Returns per-element report
Create a ParameterFilterElement with AND-combined rules and apply it to a view with graphic overrides. Updates existing filter of same name
Create global parameters, set values, and associate them to element parameters. Per-association validation and error reporting
Read instance and type parameters from elements (names, values, storage types, units). Read-back companion to set_element_parameters
Move, rotate, mirror, copy or array a batch of elements (mm/deg). Returns new element ids for copy/array
Create a view: FloorPlan, CeilingPlan, AreaPlan, Section, Elevation, 3D, or Drafting. Resolves level/view-family-type by name; optional scale and template
Create a sheet from a title block (resolved by name) and optionally auto-place views as viewports in a grid
Place one or more views as viewports on an existing sheet, at a given center or auto-arranged in a grid
Tag elements in a view by explicit ids or by category (generalizes tag_walls/tag_rooms). Picks a sensible tag type when none given
Return the model's warnings (Document.GetWarnings) grouped by description with counts, severity, and sample affected element ids
Create straight ducts from start/end points (mm) with a system type, duct type and level (resolved by name). Sets diameter or width/height per segment
Create straight pipes from start/end points (mm) with a piping system type, pipe type and level (resolved by name). Sets diameter per segment
Create straight conduits from start/end points (mm) with a conduit type and level (resolved by name). Optional diameter
Create straight cable trays from start/end points (mm) with a cable tray type and level (resolved by name). Sets width/height
Place a loadable family (MEP equipment/fixture/device, resolved by name) at points (mm) on a level, with optional Z rotation
Create MEP spaces at points (mm) on a level, or auto-place spaces in all enclosed regions. Optional tagging
Read the MEP system an element belongs to (or is): name, type, member element ids and flow. Read-only review tool
Create straight walls from start/end points (mm) with a wall type and level (resolved by name). Per-segment or default height, base offset, flip, structural flag
Create a floor from a closed boundary of points (mm) with a floor type and level (resolved by name)
Create a ceiling from a closed boundary of points (mm) with a ceiling type and level (resolved by name). Requires Revit 2022+
Create rooms at points (mm) on a level with optional names and tags, or auto-place rooms in all enclosed regions
Create an opening in a host: rectangular in a wall (two corners) or a vertical shaft through floors/roofs using the boundary profile (mm)
Load a family (.rfa) from an absolute path into the project, overwriting if it exists. Returns the family id and its type ids
Place instances of a loaded family type (resolved by name) at points (mm) on a level or host, with optional Z rotation and structural type
List loaded family types (FamilySymbols), optionally filtered by category and family name, optionally with each type's parameters. Read-only
Duplicate a loaded family type to a new named type and apply parameter overrides (mm/deg). Project context
Add a parameter to the family being edited (Family Editor only; guarded by IsFamilyDocument). Optional formula. Multi-version (ForgeTypeId 2022+)
Add a new type to the family being edited (FamilyManager.NewType). Family Editor only
Set or clear a formula on a family parameter (FamilyManager.SetFormula). Family Editor only

Open a family for editing: by familyName (EditFamily on a family loaded in the project) or by familyPath (.rfa from disk), or use the active family doc. Subsequent family_* editor tools act on it; finish with family_save_session

Save the open family (Save, or SaveAs to %TEMP% if it has no path), optionally load it back into the project (overwriting), and optionally close it. The end of a family-edit session started by family_open_session
Delete elements by id (and their dependents). Returns count removed
Duplicate any ElementType (resolved by name) to a new named type and apply parameter overrides (mm/deg)
Group elements together into a model group; optional name
Ungroup one or more groups into their member elements
Pin or unpin elements (lock position)
Rename an element or type by id
Copy parameter values from a source element to many targets (named params, or all writable)
Set a parameter on all elements matching given categories (optionally active view only). Name or BuiltInParameter; mm/deg
List the parameters available on a category (sampled from an element): names, storage types, read-only, type-vs-instance
Create a project parameter bound to categories (instance or type) without a shared parameter file
Compact identity/placement info for elements: name, category, family, type, level, host
Geometry summary per element (mm): location point/curve, length, bounding box, area, volume
Find element ids by category and optional parameter value (equals/contains), optionally active view only
Create a footprint roof from a closed boundary (mm) with a roof type and level (resolved by name)
Create a curtain wall along a line (mm) using a curtain wall type and level
Create an area plan view for an area scheme and level (resolved by name)
Place areas at points (mm) in an area plan view
Create room/area/space separation lines from a polyline (mm) in a view
Join geometry between two elements (e.g. wall and floor)
Unjoin geometry between two previously-joined elements
Create a straight-run stair between two levels at a run line (mm) with a stairs type and width, via StairsEditScope
Create railings on an existing stairs/ramp host (Treads or Stringer position) with a railing type
Create a ViewSchedule for a category with chosen fields, optional sort/group field and order. Itemized by default. Field names accept BuiltInParameter or display names
Duplicate a view (Duplicate | WithDetailing | AsDependent), optionally renaming it
Set view template, scale, crop visible/active, detail level and discipline on a view. Properties controlled by an applied template are skipped with a warning
Apply an existing ParameterFilterElement to a view: set its visibility and optional graphic overrides (color rgb, line weight, surface transparency)
Create a TextNote at a point (mm) in a view, with optional TextNoteType and wrap width (mm)
Create a FilledRegion from a boundary polygon (mm) in a detail-capable view, with an optional FilledRegionType
Create a project Revision (description, issued-to/by, issued flag) and optionally draw a RevisionCloud in a view
Create a legend view by duplicating an existing legend (Revit has no create-from-scratch API), optionally placing it on a sheet
List line patterns, or create a new LinePatternElement from alternating dash/gap segment lengths (mm). Reuses an existing pattern of the same name
List fill patterns, or create a simple parallel-line FillPatternElement (Drafting/Model) by angle (deg) and spacing (mm). Reuses an existing pattern of the same name
Set object-style line weight (projection/cut), line color (rgb) and line pattern for a category
Create (or update if it exists) a Material with shading color [r,g,b], transparency, shininess, smoothness, optional surface/cut fill patterns and an existing appearance asset. Idempotent by name
Edit an existing material's shading graphics: color, transparency, shininess, smoothness, surface/cut patterns, appearance asset
List materials with id, name, shading color, transparency and material class. Optional name substring filter
Assign a material to elements either via their Material parameter (mode=parameter, default) or by painting all faces (mode=paint)
Worksets (workshared models only): list, create, set_active, or assign elements to a workset by name
Manage links: list all, load a .rvt/.dwg/.dxf/.dgn from path, or reload/unload/remove an existing Revit link by id/name
Purge unused elements (Revit 2024+, Document.GetUnusedElements), optionally limited to categories. dryRun reports candidates without deleting
Read-only model-health summary: warning count + top warnings, group/in-place-family/link/design-option counts, unused count, worksharing status
Phases: list phases and phase filters, or set Phase Created / Phase Demolished on elements (use 'None' to clear demolished)
Create model lines from a polyline (mm) on an XY/XZ/YZ work plane through the first point; optionally closed
Create view-specific detail lines from a polyline (mm) in a view, optional line style; optionally closed
Create a DirectShape element in a category from a box (min/max mm) or an extruded profile (profile + height mm)
Create a spot elevation or spot coordinate on an element at a point (mm) in a view, with optional bend/end and leader
Create an assembly instance from member element ids (naming category taken from the first member); optional name
Create a multi-segment grid from a polyline chain (mm, >=2 points) with an optional grid type
Add U/V grid lines to a curtain wall or curtain system at points (mm) on its surface; oneSegmentOnly for a partial segment
Import an image file and place it as an ImageInstance in a view at a center point (mm)
Split elements (walls/floors/etc.) into Parts via PartUtils; returns the created part ids

FAMILY EDITOR ONLY: create a solid/void extrusion from a profile (mm), extruded by height (mm). Profile supports multiple loops (first=outer, rest=holes) with line and arc segments; the sketch plane can be XY/XZ/YZ or an arbitrary normal+origin; an optional material (name or id) is assigned to the form
FAMILY EDITOR ONLY: create a solid/void revolution from a profile (mm) about an axis (start/end mm) through start/end angles (deg)
FAMILY EDITOR ONLY: associate an element's instance parameter to a family parameter so it becomes parametric
FAMILY EDITOR ONLY: add a named reference plane from bubble end, free end and a cut-vector point (mm)
Create a single structural beam as a line-based FamilyInstance (StructuralType.Beam) from start to end (mm) on a level, with a Structural Framing type
Create a structural brace as a line-based FamilyInstance (StructuralType.Brace) from start to end (mm) on a level, with a Structural Framing type
Create a structural column as a FamilyInstance (StructuralType.Column) at a point (mm) on a base level, optional top level, with a Structural Columns type
Create an isolated structural foundation/footing as a FamilyInstance (StructuralType.Footing) at a point (mm) on a level, with a Structural Foundation type

PARENT TOOL: inspect a linked model (IFC/coordination) — element counts by category and optional per-element geometry summaries (bbox/volume in mm, link transform applied). Read-only first step of the link→native pipeline

PARENT TOOL: derive linear-member parameters (centerline start/end, section b×h, length, nearest level — all mm) from a linked element's geometry, by ids or category. Read-only; feeds struct_/arch_ create tools

PARENT TOOL: rebuild a linked model's elements of a category as native Revit elements (robust DirectShape copy), idempotent via a CEMAI app-id tag and a back-pointer to each source. Replaces the hand-written link→native recipes
PARENT TOOL: measure how far the native rebuild deviates from the source link surfaces (avg/worst mm per item, items over tolerance). Read-only QC for parent_reconstruct_native output
CEMENGAL TOOL: press a button of the Cemengal ribbon tab for the user (Filter Manager, Nested Manager, Numerate, Renamer, CEM Swap...), or list them. Never the CEM_AIModeler button
CEMENGAL TOOL: the model's types as CEM Swap lists them (placed count, creatable and why not). Read-only
CEMENGAL TOOL: the office's CEM Swap presets in SwapPresets.json. Read-only
CEMENGAL TOOL: replace elements of some types by another type through CEM Swap's engine, as a trial on one element or over every candidate; old elements are kept for the user's review
CEMENGAL TOOL: remove the CEM Swap trial standing in the model and restore the type values it changed
CEMENGAL TOOL: run every CEM_Rules rule over the whole model, as the CEM Rules button does, and return its report
